Name: Connected Garden Pots
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a visual tweak to [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Garden_Pot]garden pots[/url] that causes them to be drawn as connected to adjacent garden pots. That's all.

I mean, it's magic, but there's not much more to say about it.

If you read the source code you'd probably go, "wow", but this description remains unimpressive.


You can reskin the pots using Content Patcher and targeting:

[b]aedenthorn.ConnectedGardenPots/sprite_sheet[/b]

Just make sure you understand how the sprite sheet is laid out. The original sprite sheet is in the mod's [b]assets[/b] folder.


Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10947]Watering Can Tweaks[/url] and doesn't interfere with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11339]Wall Planters[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
